content:
Upload reference assets (e.g., images/clips) first, then describe the motion-graphics idea in text to generate polished After Effects–style motion in minutes with Seedance 2.5 (via Topview Motion Studio).  
Pick a style preset before generating to steer the output toward a specific motion-graphics look (AE-style) without using timelines or keyframes.
